parameters.name: analyzerType
parameters.description: The type of the OSS dictionary to be added. Valid values: IK_HOT, IK, SYNONYMS, and ALIWS. Default value: IK.

parameters.name: bucketName
parameters.description: The name of the OSS bucket where the dictionary file is stored.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: The storage path of the dictionary file in the OSS bucket.
